data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred in the Technical Account - General Business is a release of GBP 36,839,000 (2013: strengthening of GBP 2,107,000) being the difference between the provision for claims outstanding at the beginning of the year less payments made during the year on account of claims incurred in previous years and the provision for claims outstanding at the end of the year for such claims. The net release in 2014 was the result of favourable development on prior year catastrophe and attritional losses, in particular on reinsurance segments, offsetting deterioration in the estimated ultimate Motor liabilities.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a net prior-year release of GBP 36.839m in 2014 (1.64% of opening gross claims outstanding). The release reflects favourable development on prior-year catastrophe and attritional losses, notably within reinsurance segments, which was partly offset by adverse development in Motor liabilities.

data.data_quality_notes: No gross prior-year movement (gross change in provision for prior years) was found in the reported notes. The report explicitly states a net prior-year release of GBP 36,839,000; per extraction rules this net figure (after reinsurance) is used as a fallback. Gross movement not available in the provided pages, so prior_year_development_gbp_m is NET of reinsurance.
